sketches.mechanism: The `finally` block always executes, even after a return — the thing you cannot skip no matter how you try to leave.
sketches.resonance: Grief runs after every attempt to move on; the finally block ensures something always follows you out.

sketches.mechanism: The `never` type represents values that can never occur — a function returning `never` cannot complete normally.
sketches.resonance: A promise typed as never is one the type system itself guarantees can never be fulfilled.

sketches.mechanism: The `method_missing` hook intercepts calls to methods that don't exist, responding to names that were never defined.
sketches.resonance: You keep calling out and something answers, but it was never really there — just an echo shaped like a reply.
sketches.draft:
class Echo
  def method_missing(name, *)
    name
  end
end

echo = Echo.new
echo.are_you_there
echo.please
echo.answer_me
